candidates.description: This vector represents Italian adjectives and quantifiers commonly used to describe qualities, difficulty, or amounts.
This vector represents modifiers of magnitude, frequency, or professional status that intensify or qualify nouns and adjectives.
This feature vector represents common Italian interrogative and relative pronouns, conjunctions, and adverbial connectors.
This vector represents descriptors of categorization, skill level, or operational standard (e.g., professional, amateur, standard).

This vector activates on common verb-forming suffixes and inflectional roots across Romance languages, particularly related to causative and process verbs ending in "-ificar", "-izzare", or their English equivalents.
This vector represents numerical values, specifically integer quantities or measurements.
This vector represents Spanish adverbial suffixes and related adverb-forming morphemes or adverbs.
This vector represents Italian verb infinitive endings and words ending with the "-are" or "-ire" suffix.
This feature vector represents morphological roots, stems, and affixes related to Latin-derived verbs and logical conclusion, determination, or composition.
This vector activates strongly for words related to sports, games, and athletic activities.
